settings.title: Story & Measure

content.headline: Marketing with a story worth telling — and numbers worth keeping.
content.subheadline: Story & Measure is the marketing studio of Jodi Esposito. Brand narrative, campaigns, and analytics for small businesses and founders who need every marketing dollar to earn its keep.

content.headline: What the studio does
content.subheadline: Every engagement pairs the two halves of the name: a story your customers repeat, and a measurement plan that shows whether it worked.

features.title: Brand & Messaging
features.description: Positioning, voice, and a messaging house you can hand to any writer or agency and get consistent work back.

features.title: Content Marketing
features.description: Editorial calendars, newsletters, and long-form content built around what your customers actually search for and share.

features.title: Campaign Strategy
features.description: Launches, seasonal pushes, and paid campaigns planned end to end — channels, creative briefs, budgets, and timing.

features.title: Analytics & Reporting
features.description: A measurement plan before the first post goes out, and a monthly dashboard that answers "was it worth it?" in plain English.

features.title: Audience Research
features.description: Customer interviews and survey programs that replace guessing with quotes and data you can build campaigns on.

features.title: Launch Sprints
features.description: Six-week engagements to take one product, service, or rebrand from rough idea to live campaign with clear success criteria.

testimonials.quote: Jodi rewrote our story in a way that finally sounded like us — then showed us, month by month, that it was pulling in better-fit customers.

testimonials.quote: We'd been running ads on instinct for two years. Story & Measure cut our spend by a third and our inbound leads went up. The dashboard alone is worth the retainer.

testimonials.quote: The launch sprint was the most organized six weeks of marketing we've ever done. Clear plan, clear numbers, no fluff.
testimonials.author: Priya Raman

items.question: Who is Story & Measure for?
items.answer: Small businesses, founders, and lean teams — usually without a full-time marketer — who want senior-level marketing strategy without hiring an agency of record. Jodi works with a small number of clients at a time so every engagement gets principal-level attention.

items.question: Who will I actually work with?
items.answer: Jodi Esposito, directly. Story & Measure is deliberately a studio of one, with a trusted bench of designers and media buyers brought in per project when the work calls for it.

items.question: How do engagements start?
items.answer: Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call, followed by a short written assessment of where your marketing stands and what the first 90 days should look like. No commitment until you've seen the plan.

items.question: What does "measure" mean in practice?
items.answer: Before any campaign launches, we agree on what success looks like — leads, bookings, sales, sign-ups — and set up the tracking to capture it. You get a monthly report that says what ran, what it cost, and what it returned.

content.headline: Simple packages, honest scope
content.subheadline: Three ways to work together. Every package includes a measurement plan and a monthly plain-English report.

items.question: Can I start small and grow into a retainer?
items.answer: That's the most common path. Most retainer clients started with a Story Session — it doubles as the foundation for everything that follows, and its fee is credited toward your first retainer month.

items.question: Do packages include ad spend?
items.answer: No — media budgets are billed directly to you by the platforms, so you always own your accounts and your data. Package fees cover strategy, creative direction, and management.

items.question: What if my project doesn't fit a package?
items.answer: Packages are starting points, not boxes. Book a discovery call and Jodi will scope something that fits — or tell you honestly if you don't need her yet.

content.headline: Let's talk about your story
content.subheadline: Tell Jodi a little about your business and what you're hoping marketing will do for it. You'll hear back within one business day.
